build_sampler_for_algorithm: build a sampler for a CLRS algorithm like bfs using samplers.build_sampler with num_samples and length
test_sampler_determinism: test that samplers produce identical outputs across different numpy random seeds for all CLRS-30 algorithms
test_sampler_batch_determinism: test that two samplers with the same seed produce identical batched feedback outputs
test_trunc_array: test the trunc_array method to verify float numpy arrays are truncated to specified decimal places
test_process_random_pos: test process_random_pos to verify randomized position inputs replace fixed uniformly spaced pos values
